name: ship
licence: the project's own generated geometry: no extract, no sample, no trace, so unlike the drive and quay class files this one carries no ODbL line
source_map: data/maps/all.json, the ship_small and ship_cabin rows, read only
rule: every tile in assets/tiles/ship/ship_tiles.png appears here once, by index and by name, with walkable true or false and the reason, and the hatch and the rail are marked by name; a tile missing from this file cannot be placed by the map wiring
not_walkable_rule: a tile is not walkable when it is a wall, a fitting or furniture, when it is the edge of the ship, or when it is water

hatch.rule: the closed hatch is not walkable and is the flag gated cell (collision 2 in the data/maps/all.json convention); the open hatch is walkable and carries the ladder_down trigger

rail.rule: the rail is the edge of the ship: not walkable, stood on the deck plate it guards, with the water in the next row below it

tiles.name: deck_plate
tiles.reason: a deck plate is the floor the fight happens on

tiles.name: deck_plate_worn
tiles.reason: a deck plate is the floor the fight happens on

tiles.name: deck_line
tiles.reason: paint on a deck plate: it does not stop a step

tiles.name: deck_grating
tiles.reason: grating is walked on; the engine space and the catwalk are laid in it

tiles.name: deck_grating_cross
tiles.reason: grating is walked on, and the member is flush enough to step over

tiles.name: hatch_closed
tiles.reason: a shut hatch is a solid: the map blocks it, and it is the blocked until story flag cell

tiles.name: hatch_open
tiles.reason: an open hatch is the way down: walkable, and it is the cell the ladder_down trigger sits on

tiles.name: door_sill
tiles.reason: a sill is a step of two pixels: crossable, so the map does not block it

tiles.name: bulkhead_rivet
tiles.reason: a bulkhead is a wall

tiles.name: bulkhead_plain
tiles.reason: a bulkhead is a wall

tiles.name: bulkhead_light
tiles.reason: a fitting on a wall: it is not ground

tiles.name: ladder
tiles.reason: a ladder is climbed, not walked around; the map lets a step onto it

tiles.name: stairs_up
tiles.reason: a stair is climbed, so it is not a solid

tiles.name: pipe_run
tiles.reason: a pipe run stands proud of the wall: a solid

tiles.name: locker
tiles.reason: a locker is furniture: a solid

tiles.name: crate
tiles.reason: a crate is a solid the hold is furnished with

tiles.name: hazard_stripes
tiles.reason: paint on a deck: it marks a hazard, it is not one

tiles.name: rail_post
tiles.reason: the rail is the edge of the ship: a solid, and the deck ends at it

tiles.name: rail_bar
tiles.reason: the rail is the edge of the ship: a solid, and the water is under it

tiles.name: porthole
tiles.reason: a porthole is set in a bulkhead: a solid

tiles.name: log_terminal
tiles.reason: a terminal is mounted on a wall: it is the save point, not ground

tiles.name: water_deep
tiles.reason: you cannot walk on the sea

tiles.name: water_swell
tiles.reason: you cannot walk on the sea

tiles.name: water_edge
tiles.reason: the waterline is water: the hull beside it is a solid too
